title: IT Projects Coordinator Managed-Services (m/w/d)
description:

And do you want to make healthcare safer, better and more reliable?
Join our Team!

• Du verfügst über eine strukturierte sowie eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und arbeitest gerne im Team.

• Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit attraktivem Gehalt für eine langfristige Perspektive

• Verantwortungsvolle und spannende Aufgaben in einer zukunftsorientierten Branche

• Professionelles Onboarding

• Nette Kollegen, die Dich gerne unterstützen und mit denen du auf „DU-Ebene“ bist

• Gesamte Hardware- und Softwareausstattung für ein angenehmes Arbeiten im Homeoffice

• Möglichkeit eines Jobtickets

• Möglichkeit eines Job-Rads

• Kostenlose Firmenkreditkarte

Jeder Mensch ist Ausgangs- und Zielpunkt unserer Aktivitäten - und letztlich der wichtigste Nutznießer. Deshalb sind wir stolz auf das, was wir jeden Tag tun.

title: Senior AI Quality Engineer
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We're hiring two Senior Quality Engineers to set up a Quality Engineering department at Lendable alongside a new Head of Quality.

At Lendable we already have a number of profitable, award winning credit products. They have a good automated quality story. However, as our customer base has grown into the millions we need to keep evolving to keep the quality bar high. Advances in AI engineering also have enabled us to ship faster, but we need to ensure we are not regressing on our quality metrics.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - AI Agents, test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers. You won't be executing tests by hand. You'll work cross-functionally with software engineers, product and design. Quality is a team-level responsibility and your job is to work with teams to enable them to improve their quality processes by hands-on collaboration.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

ENABLE TEAMS TO KEEP THE QUALITY BAR HIGH

- Rotating around different product teams for short periods to level up quality

- Define and evolve the pragmatic test pyramid for our products - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where testing belongs in faster layers (unit and component tests)

- Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across our products

- Devise and set up performance benchmarks to ensure critical parts of our systems don't regress

BRING AI TESTING INTO THE SDLC

- Speed up our SDLC by building agents that exploratory test changes and catch issues before they get to production

- Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes

- Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A test suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on

BUILD RELIABLE E2E AUTOMATION

- Discover gaps in testing and help teams build comprehensive suites

- Get test environments and data fixtures to a level where they are easy to use and reliable

- Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green

PREVENT DEFECTS, NOT JUST CATCH THEM

- Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early,

title: Growth Manager
description:
As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end. You will set the strategy, ship the work, measure the outcomes, and decide what to build next. This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.
The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.
💡 Interested in applying?
🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.
Attention to detail is one of our core values ! This is your chance to stand out :)
To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

• Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.

• AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.

• Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.

• Self-directed . You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.

• Curious about new tools as they ship . You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.

• Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.

• Content and copy production : blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.

• Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.

• Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.

• Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.

• Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

• Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.

• Real AI-augmented work . Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.

• Email and lifecycle depth . You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.

• CRO chops . You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.

• Full-stack execution . Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.

• Hungry over knowledgeable . You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.

title: Director, Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Management
description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank .
About the Role
Fifth Third Bank is seeking a Director of Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Management to lead two critical cybersecurity functions: Enterprise Vulnerability Remediation and Exposure Analysis & Coordination.
This leader is responsible for reducing enterprise cyber risk by driving vulnerability remediation and coordinating the response to significant technology exposures across the Bank. The role combines strategic leadership and operational execution, partnering with senior technology leaders to prioritize remediation efforts, improve exposure management processes, and strengthen the Bank's cybersecurity posture.
In addition to leading the vulnerability remediation program, this Director will help mature a growing Exposure Analysis & Coordination capability focused on rapidly assessing and coordinating the Bank's response to emerging cybersecurity risks that require urgent action and cross-functional engagement.
This is a highly visible leadership role that partners closely with Information Security, Technology, Risk Management, and executive leadership.
What You'll Do
Lead Enterprise Vulnerability Remediation

• Lead the enterprise vulnerability remediation program, including governance, reporting, escalation, and stakeholder coordination.

• Partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to drive timely risk reduction.

• Establish remediation priorities, performance metrics, and service-level expectations.

• Support audits, regulatory examinations, and enterprise risk governance activities.

• Continuously improve remediation workflows, reporting, and prioritization processes.

Lead Exposure Analysis & Coordination

• Lead the Bank's Exposure Analysis & Coordination function.

•
Coordinate enterprise response to significant technology exposures, including:

• Zero-day vulnerabilities

• Emerging and pre-CVE threats

• Vendor advisories

• Third-party technology exposures

• Cloud security exposures

• Drive cross-functional assessment, prioritization, mitigation tracking, and executive communications.

• Ensure significant exposure events are consistently governed, documented, escalated, and resolved.

• Lead post-event reviews and operational improvements.

Drive Risk-Based Decision Making

• Translate vulnerability, threat, and exposure data into actionable risk decisions.

• Advise senior leaders on remediation priorities, business impact, and risk tradeoffs.

• Identify systemic issues and opportunities for long-term risk reduction.

Lead Strategy & Continuous Improvement

• Define strategy, roadmaps, metrics, and maturity objectives for the Remediation and Exposure Management functions.

• Establish scalable operating processes, playbooks, and governance models.

• Drive continuous improvement using Agile and Lean practices.

• Align cybersecurity priorities with technology investment, capacity, and risk reduction objectives.

Build High-Performing Teams

• Lead and develop security engineers and analysts.

• Coach emerging leaders and strengthen organizational capabilities.

• Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure teams can effectively support both planned remediation efforts and rapidly evolving cyber threats.

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, security operations, vulnerability management, or related disciplines.

• Experience leading enterprise-scale remediation, risk reduction, security operations, or response coordination programs.

• Strong knowledge of vulnerability management practices, risk prioritization methodologies, and cyber risk governance.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large cross-functional initiatives across complex organizations.

• Experience presenting to senior leaders and executive audiences.

title: Senior Quality Test Engineer
description:

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.

A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family , we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.

Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

The Test Engineer supports the testing of our autonomous vehicles in addition to software development and engineering activities supporting the delivery of software tools, automation, and CI/CD pipelines within our Autonomous Eco System. Responsibilities include generating and executing vehicle test plans, analyzing the resulting test data, designing strategic test progression, and supporting full-lifecycle development of proprietary software solutions for the testing and delivery of our Autonomous Eco System. This position is instrumental in improving the robustness and safety of our self-driving technology, and works closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ensure robust, safety-focused testing and delivery.

What You'll Do

Vehicle Software Testing

•
Generate and execute test plans to uncover the limitations of our systems, collecting relevant data to drive improvements.

•
Perform root cause analysis of identified defects and performance issues, and provide recommended solutions.

•
Design and deploy supplementary instrumentation and infrastructure required to capture data as defined by the test plans.

•
Analyze test data and generate reports to communicate performance issues and capability improvements over time.

•
Maintain a verification and validation report showing current performance of the vehicle-level system against system requirements.

•
Work closely with software component teams to generate quantifiable performance metrics and implement vehicle-level tests for individual system components.

•
Provide regular reports to software component and system design teams, consolidating test event results and generating detailed defect reports with supporting logs.

•
Perform on-road testing in autonomous vehicles as a detailed observer/annotator.

•
Travel domestically or internationally to support on-road vehicle testing, up to 25%.

Software Engineering

•
Execute full software development lifecycle activities using a mixture of C++ and scripting languages in a Linux development environment, using Lean-Agile methodologies.

•
Complete software assignments including design, implementation, unit testing, vehicle testing, and deployed software maintenance, following quality, build, deploy, test, safety, and process requirements and guidelines.

•
Assist in root cause analysis of issues found in testing and process automation steps.

•
Support the team in identifying daily assignments and reporting progress at daily stand-ups.

•
Support software and system-level test plans and verification strategies for ongoing feature development and bug fixes.

•
Design and implement systems responsible for data acquisition and analysis from remote vehicles in the field.

•
Ensure software updates do not regress software performance by utilizing simulation software and scenarios.

•
Bring a genuine passion for the autonomy technology product area.

What You'll Need to Succeed

Education, Licensing, and Certifications Required

•
Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or another relevant technical field with 6+ years of technically relevant work experience, OR

•
Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or another relevant technical field with 3+ years

title: Compensation and Benefits Specialist
description:
Get reward right and people stay, perform and talk about their employer for all the right reasons. Get it wrong and even the strongest culture quietly leaks talent.
Job Overview
Our UK-based client is hiring a Compensation and Benefits Specialist to take full ownership of reward across their growing business. This is a full-time, fully remote position for a South African professional who pairs analytical precision with absolute discretion. You will benchmark, design and administer the salary structures and benefits programmes that keep the business competitive and its people committed.
About Our Client
Our client is an established UK company that treats fair, transparent reward as a growth lever rather than an admin task. With a team that is scaling steadily, they want pay decisions grounded in data instead of guesswork, and they are investing in a dedicated specialist to make that happen. You will work closely with HR and finance leadership and be trusted with meaningful ownership from your first month.
Key Responsibilities

• Benchmark salaries against UK and international market data and maintain accurate, defensible pay bands

• Administer benefits programmes end-to-end, from enrolments and amendments to renewals and provider negotiations

• Run the annual compensation review cycle, including modelling scenarios, budgets and approval packs

• Prepare accurate, fully documented payroll inputs for every reward change

• Track legislative and compliance developments affecting pay and benefits, updating policies before they become problems

• Build clear reports and dashboards so leadership can see reward costs and trends at a glance

What You Will Be Doing Day-to-Day
Expect a rhythm of focused analytical work and steady collaboration. You will maintain benchmarking data, answer employee benefits queries with patience and clarity, prepare monthly reward reports, and work with finance to keep costs forecast and controlled. During review season you become the engine room of the process: building models, sanity-checking proposals and ensuring every decision is documented. Throughout it all, you protect confidentiality without exception, because in this role trust is the whole job.
If you are a detail-driven professional based in South Africa who wants reward work with real scope and a long-term remote career, this role will stretch you in the best way.
Requirements

• 4+ years' experience in compensation, benefits or reward analysis

• Excellent written and spoken English, able to explain reward decisions clearly and confidently

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including modelling and lookups, plus experience with HRIS platforms

• Proven reliability: stable fibre internet, backup power for load shedding, and a professional home office

• Strong working knowledge of payroll inputs, benefits administration and compliance requirements

• Absolute discretion when handling sensitive salary and personal data

Benefits
Full-time remote position working for a UK-based employer. Competitive salary paid in ZAR. Long-term stable role. Supportive team environment. Direct access to founder-led business.

title: Clinical Trial Quality Control Manager (Site Oversight) - Remote
description:
Primary Function:
The Clinical QC Manager is a Clinical Operations-based role responsible for conducting independent quality control (QC) assessments to confirm that investigational sites are executing clinical trials in accordance with study protocols, GCP, and company procedures. This role performs targeted, risk‑based QC oversight through on‑site QC visits and focused documentation and process reviews to verify that critical study activities are being performed as intended.
Working in partnership with Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs), CRAs, and other Clinical Operations staff, the Clinical QC Manager independently assesses site execution and protocol adherence and collaborates with the study team on follow‑up actions. The role identifies protocol adherence gaps, recurring operational issues, and process risks, and supports timely follow‑up with accountable owners. This position does not replace routine monitoring activities or serve as the primary site management function; rather, it strengthens study execution by evaluating site processes, identifying trends, and supporting issue resolution across studies.
This position reports to the Executive Director, Head of US Clinical Operations, and is based remotely. Frequent travel to investigational sites is required to support on‑site QC visits and assessments.
Major Responsibilities and Duties:
QC Planning, Assessments, and Reporting

• Develop and maintain study‑specific QC plans, updating based on study progress, complexity, and risk assessment.

• Create and maintain QC tools (e.g., checklists, templates, trackers) to support consistent execution of QC activities.

• Conduct risk‑based, on‑site QC visits to investigational sites to assess protocol adherence and execution of critical study processes (e.g., informed consent process checks, protocol‑required procedures, safety reporting processes, and essential document maintenance).

• Conduct in‑house QC activities (remote or in‑office reviews) as needed, ensuring QC activities are completed within defined timelines and quality expectations.

• Evaluate site processes and documentation to confirm studies are being conducted consistently and as intended.

• Prepare clear, objective QC Visit Reports documenting scope, observations, trends, and required follow‑up actions.

• Escalate significant compliance, patient safety, or data integrity concerns through defined Clinical Operations escalation pathways.

Issue Identification, Follow‑Up, and Trend Analysis

• On a regular basis, in partnership with Clinical Operations teams, identify protocol deviations, recurring site‑level issues, and operational risks through QC activities.

• Support study teams with root cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to the development of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), as needed.

• Track QC findings and follow‑up actions to closure and contribute to cross‑site and cross‑study trend analysis.

Inspection Readiness Support

• Support inspection readiness activities across preparation, conduct, and follow‑up phases, including self‑checks and targeted readiness reviews.

• Perform targeted reviews of site and study documentation as part of QC assessments to support ongoing inspection readiness.

• Provide QC summaries and documentation to Clinical Operations leadership and study teams, as requested.

Training, Knowledge Sharing, and Operational Improvement

• Contribute to training activities for Clinical Operations teams based on QC findings, common site execution gaps, and protocol adherence challenges.

• Incorporate lessons learned from QC activities and regulatory inspections into training, guidance, and study team communications.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement based on QC observations and trends.

• Support implementation of applicable SOPs and study processes by reinforcing procedural expectations and providing training or clarification on relevant procedures.

title: Staff Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
About the Team
People love using HubSpot because it’s an essential product that gives them the tools and insights they need to grow their business. Trellis is HubSpot ’s enterprise design system, the shared foundation that powers product surfaces across CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Commerce Hub, Breeze AI, and the growing portfolio of agentic experiences.
Trellis is not a style guide or a Figma library. It is the connective tissue between design intent and product reality at scale: a living system of tokens, components, patterns, documentation, and tooling that designers and engineers across HubSpot depend on every day to build with speed, quality, accessibility, and consistency.
We are at a defining inflection point. AI is fundamentally expanding what a design system needs to be. In the AI native era, Trellis must be machine readable as well as human readable. Tokens need semantic structure that AI tools can reason about. Components and patterns need usage guidance that helps teams make better decisions earlier. Documentation needs to serve the designer working in Figma, the engineer implementing in code, and the AI assisted tool generating product UI.
This is the environment you’re stepping into, and it is exactly the right moment to shape how HubSpot builds.
About this Role
We are hiring three Staff Product Designers to help shape the next phase of Trellis, HubSpot ’s enterprise design system. These roles share the same broader mission: helping product teams across HubSpot build faster, more consistently, and with a higher quality bar as our platform becomes more connected, adaptive, and AI native.
Each role will focus on a different part of the system:
Tokens and Visual Language
This role owns the foundational visual system behind Trellis, including color, typography, spacing, iconography, motion, theming, density, semantic tokens, and the visual quality bar for how HubSpot shows up in product. This person will help evolve Trellis’ token architecture and visual language so it can scale across product surfaces, support AI assisted development, and remain coherent as the platform grows.
Components
This role owns the reusable building blocks product teams use every day, including component anatomy, behavior, variants, states, accessibility, documentation, implementation guidance, and Figma to code alignment. This person will help define what belongs in the shared system, how components should behave, and how Trellis can reduce fragmentation across teams without slowing product development.
Patterns
This role owns the repeatable product behaviors and interaction models that show up across HubSpot , such as creation, editing, filtering, search, object management, permissions, notifications, recommendations, and AI assisted workflows. This person will help product teams solve common problems in more consistent ways and make HubSpot feel more coherent across connected customer workflows.
Across all three roles, you’ll work at the intersection of product design, systems thinking, craft, engineering partnership, governance, adoption, documentation, and implementation quality. You will make decisions that affect many product teams and help define how a large B2B platform builds product in an AI native era.
This is not a role where you simply maintain what exists. Trellis is in a multi-year modernization journey, and this team is helping make the system trusted, self-serve, and useful in day-to-day product development. You will help reduce fragmentation, improve system adoption, shape contribution models, and create the shared foundations that let HubSpot build with more speed and quality at scale.

• Own and evolve a major focus area within Trellis, either Tokens and Visual Language, Components, or Patterns

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk Operations Technology Enablement team sits within the Risk Operations org and is responsible for partnering across Risk teams to shape the technical infrastructure that enables us to scale our Risk operations and achieve our dual goals of preventing bad actors from exploiting Stripe’s systems and delivering an exceptional user experience for legitimate users. More specifically, our team partners with Risk product and engineering teams to identify, scope, prioritize, pilot, and roll out technical infrastructure and tooling improvements to protect Stripe and serve our users. From the application of AI to our reviews, to agent diagnostic and resolution tools, to review and support case routing, to our user-facing risk support surfaces, our team’s mandate is expansive and a major lever in both protecting Stripe and its users from risk as well as improving the user experience.

Scratch Financial (“Scratch”) is a Series C financial technology startup based in Los Angeles, California. Our goal is to make difficult financial decisions simple and increase accessibility to fair, affordable, and transparent medical financing. Driven by our award-winning technology, Scratch has become the fastest growing financing provider in veterinary care, with a partner network of 15,000+ practices across the U.S. and Canada.

About the role

As Sr. Product Manager for Lending , you'll have end-to-end ownership of Scratch's lending products, from origination through underwriting and servicing. You'll set the strategy and roadmap for how we extend fair, affordable credit to pet parents, working closely with engineering, design, risk, credit, finance, servicing, compliance, and our sponsor bank partners to build lending experiences that are fast, transparent, and responsible.

What you'll do

• Assist the strategy, roadmap, and execution for lending products, including:

•

• Point-of-sale lending and BNPL offerings

• Longer-term installment and payment plans

• Credit decisioning and application flows

• Loan servicing and account management tools

• Feature flag management across lending environments

• Creation of new offerings such as wellness and/or subscription services

• Manage and grow relationships with sponsor bank partners as well as our loan management software provider, ensuring product decisions align with partnership agreements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements

• Own and evolve partner API solutions, including integrations with credit bureaus and alternative data providers for underwriting and risk model scoring

• Own and evolve customer facing tools such as the application funnel and borrower servicing portal

• Partner with data science and risk teams to build and refine cashflow underwriting tools and credit risk models that improve approval rates while managing loss exposure

• Drive a rigorous testing and experimentation practice, including A/B testing of underwriting criteria, application flows, and servicing experiences

• Own clear, thorough documentation of product requirements, underwriting logic, and decisioning rules for cross-functional and regulatory audiences

• Collaborate with legal, compliance, and operations to ensure lending products meet all applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., state lending laws, TILA/Reg Z, fair lending)

• Act as the product alpha for all things lending, making data-driven decisions using both internal performance data and external benchmarks

What we are looking for

• Deep knowledge of consumer lending: underwriting, credit decisioning, loan origination, servicing, collections, and the regulatory landscape (state lending laws, TILA/Reg Z, fair lending, etc.)

• Experience operating and navigating sponsor-bank partnership models

• Experience with partner APIs to facilitate b2b client relationships

• Familiarity with data ingestion and advanced model scoring, ideally related to underwriting and credit risk model scoring using credit bureau ((e.g., Experian, Equifax, TransUnion) or alternative data sources (e.g. cashflow underwriting)

• Strong experimentation muscle, including hands-on experience running A/B tests to optimize underwriting and product outcomes

• Comfort with prototyping and iterating quickly with design and engineering to test new lending concept

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are seeking an experienced Structured Cabling Design Engineer to support the design and delivery of structured cabling and physical network infrastructure for hyperscale and enterprise data center environments.

This remote position will be responsible for developing scalable, standards-compliant fiber and copper cabling designs from concept through construction and deployment. The engineer will work closely with data center design, network engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and deployment teams to ensure cabling infrastructure meets capacity, reliability, maintainability, and future-growth requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop end-to-end structured cabling designs for new-build, expansion, retrofit, and capacity-add data center projects.

• Design fiber-optic and copper cabling systems supporting data center network, compute, storage, management, security, and building infrastructure.

• Develop MDF, IDF, MMR, network room, meet-me-room, and data hall connectivity designs .

• Create fiber backbone, horizontal cabling, interconnect, cross-connect, and equipment connectivity architectures.

• Develop single-line diagrams, cabling schematics, rack elevations, patching diagrams, pathway layouts, fiber routing plans, and connectivity schedules .

• Determine fiber counts, cable types, connector types, patch-panel requirements, termination methods, and pathway capacity.

• Design solutions using single-mode and multimode fiber , including high-density fiber connectivity and MPO/MTP-based systems where applicable.

• Specify Category 6/6A copper infrastructure and associated patching systems.

• Perform cable pathway, tray, conduit, ladder rack, and containment capacity calculations.

• Coordinate structured cabling requirements with network architecture, electrical, mechanical, architectural, security, and construction disciplines.

• Review construction drawings, BIM/CAD models, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and vendor proposals.

• Develop Bills of Materials (BOMs) and support material forecasting and procurement.

• Create and maintain cabling standards, design guidelines, naming conventions, labeling requirements, and installation specifications.

• Ensure designs comply with applicable TIA, BICSI, IEEE, NEC/NFPA, ISO/IEC, and manufacturer standards .

• Support data center capacity planning and determine future fiber, copper, rack, and pathway requirements.

• Review contractor installation packages and ensure field implementation aligns with approved designs.

• Support fiber testing, copper certification, commissioning, punch-list resolution, and project closeout.

• Review OTDR, insertion-loss, and certification test results where applicable.

• Participate remotely in design reviews, construction coordination meetings, and technical troubleshooting.

• Conduct occasional site surveys and field inspections when required.

• Identify design risks, constructability issues, capacity constraints, and opportunities for standardization.

• Maintain accurate as-built documentation, cable schedules, port assignments, rack elevations, and connectivity records .

• Work across multiple concurrent data center projects while maintaining design qu

description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français.

L'OPPORTUNITÉ : SOYONS CLAIRS DÈS LE DÉPART

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients.

Si tu cherches un rôle de management à distance, derrière un tableau Excel, ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi. Si tu veux gagner ta légitimité sur le terrain avant de prendre les rênes, continue à lire.

TES MISSIONS

- Maîtrise des outils : CRM impeccable, pipeline propre, reporting fiable; tu appliques ce que tu exigeras plus tard de ton équipe.

PHASE 2 : TU CONSTRUIS ET TU DIRIGES.

- Constitution de ton équipe : Tu participes au recrutement et fais grandir ton équipe jusqu'à environ 5 personnes (et plus en cas de succès).

- Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures.

- Structure & coaching : Tu organises la semaine, tu animes les 1:1 et les roleplays, tu lèves les obstacles rapidement et tu veilles à la rigueur du CRM de toute l'équipe.

- Pilotage par les chiffres : Tu connais les indicateurs clés de chaque membre de ton équipe et tu pilotes activement la performance.

- Culture & motivation : Tu crées des challenges d'équipe, tu renforces la culture sales et tu fais en sorte que chacun(e) progresse en continu.

TON PROFIL

- Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne.

- Potentiel de leadership : Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir déjà été manager, mais tu as l'envie et le talent de prendre la responsabilité d'une région et de mener une équipe au succès.

- Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région.

- Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM.

- Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région d'Amiens et alentours.

- Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales..

The Associate Director, Clinical Quality & Compliance (CQC), serves as a strategic quality leader within R&D Quality & Compliance (RDQC), providing oversight, guidance, and expertise to support the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) across Research, Development, and Medical (RD&M).
This role is responsible for driving a culture of quality and compliance through leadership of Vendor Quality Governance activities, Functional Quality Representation (FQR) for clinical studies, quality risk management, investigations, CAPA oversight, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Associate Director partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to proactively identify quality risks, implement sustainable solutions, and ensure compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards.
The incumbent plays a critical role in protecting study participants, preserving scientific integrity, and ensuring the quality and reliability of clinical data throughout the development lifecycle.
** While this is a remote-based role, it is strongly preferred that the employee is located within either the Eastern or Central Time Zones. **
What You’ll Do

• Serve as the Clinical Quality & Compliance representative for assigned studies, programs, and functional areas, providing expert guidance on quality and compliance matters.

• Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System by driving quality governance, process enhancement, and compliance initiatives.

• Drive Vendor Quality Governance activities, including vendor qualification, performance oversight, quality risk assessments, issue management, and remediation activities.

• Partner with vendor quality representatives and internal stakeholders to ensure vendor compliance with global regulations, industry standards, and contractual quality obligations.

• Support internal audits, sponsor audits, investigator site audits, and regulatory inspections through preparation, risk assessment, response management, and inspection readiness activities.

• Identify emerging compliance risks and recommend proactive mitigation strategies that strengthen quality performance and organizational readiness.

• Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance.

• Monitor quality trends and metrics, providing insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and continuous quality improvement.

Who You Are
You are a strategic and collaborative quality professional with deep expertise in clinical development, GCP compliance, and quality systems. You are comfortable operating independently, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and providing practical solutions to complex quality and compliance challenges. You excel in risk-based decision making, foster strong partnerships across functions, and are passionate about advancing a culture of quality that supports both patient safety and business objectives. You bring strong leadership, analytical thinking, and communication skill

title: Senior SDET - Test Automation & Performance Engineering | Contract | Remote MX
description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies - from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms - and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:
We are looking for a Senior SDET / Test Automation Engineer for a project based assignment to build the automated testing and release systems that ensure our products remain reliable as traffic, data volume, integrations, partners, and release velocity increase. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on test automation, API and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, and CI/CD quality gates within an AWS-based environment.
This is not a manual QA position. You will design and build reusable test infrastructure, automate critical product and partner workflows, create realistic performance scenarios, and provide engineering teams with clear evidence of whether a release is ready for production.
You will work closely with engineering teams and the Performance & Reliability Engineering Lead to ensure quality and scalability are built into the development lifecycle rather than treated as a final release checkpoint.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and evolve the automated testing architecture across products and engineering teams

• Build and maintain automated API, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, and UI tests where appropriate

• Develop reusable test frameworks, fixtures, synthetic data, mocks, and environment strategies

• Build automated testing for distributed services and integrations running within AWS environments

• Design and execute load, stress, spike, soak, scalability, degradation, and recovery tests

• Translate performance and capacity scenarios into repeatable automated test suites with measurable pass/fail thresholds

• Model realistic workloads, concurrency levels, traffic patterns, data volumes, and dependency behavior

• Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish enforceable quality and release gates

• Create automated release checks tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds

• Establish practices for identifying, quarantining, diagnosing, and eliminating flaky tests

• Improve test observability and failure reporting so engineers can quickly understand and diagnose issues

• Build and maintain reliable test data and test environment strategies

• Debug failures across APIs, services, databases, infrastructure, and external integrations

• Partner with Performance & Reliability Engineering to validate scalability assumptions and production readiness

• Partner with Security Engineering on permissions, isolation, negative-path, and abuse-related test scenarios

• Track testing trends and help reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, manual release effort, and regression risk

• Coach engineers on testability, automation, quality ownership, and defect-prevention practices

Required Skills:

• Strong experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Test Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, or similar engineering-focused testing role

• Strong software development and test automation skills

• Experience testing APIs, distributed services, integrations, and cloud-based applications

• Hands-on experience working within AWS environments

• Strong experience building automated API and integration test frameworks

• Hands-on performance and scalability testing experience using tools such as k6, Gatling, Locust, JMeter, or equivalent

• Experience designing realistic performance workloads rather than simply executing predefined load tests

description:
ABOUT BUFFER

We create social media and brand-building software for small businesses, creators, and individuals. Our mission is to provide essential tools to help small businesses get off the ground and grow. Through exceptional customer service and uplifting content, we help our customers believe they can succeed and do good along the way.

Buffer is a fully distributed team, and we’ve always aimed to do things a little differently at Buffer. Since the early days, we’ve focused on building one of the most unique and fulfilling workplaces by rethinking a lot of traditional practices. We also default to transparency, so you can read all about our metrics, and our successes and failures along the way on our Transparency Dashboard https://buffer.com/open.

We're united by Buffer's values https://buffer.com/about#values, and we hire and work from all over the world. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive work environment, and we are building a culture where underrepresented groups are welcome and can flourish. Please note that we do travel to work together in person once or twice per year, and those events are highly encouraged to build deeper connections among our small team.

As you get to know Buffer and consider joining the journey, you can learn more about Buffer on our Journey https://buffer.com/journey page. Still curious to learn more about the experience on the Buffer team? Feel free to read more from Kirsti https://buffer.com/resources/first-30-days-buffer/ and Sabreen https://buffer.com/resources/joined-3-days-before-the-retreat/ as they share their first experiences with Buffer, as well as from Hailley https://buffer.com/resources/8-years-at-buffer/, who captured why she still calls Buffer home after 8+ years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Design Engineer to join Buffer's Marketing team. You'll be the engineer closest to how Buffer looks and feels on the web - owning our front-end design system, building performant components, and crafting the interactions and animations that bring our pages to life. This is a small, agile team where members are trusted to manage their own time, and where you'll work across brand, product marketing, and growth projects.

Buffer recently went through a significant brand redesign, and now we want to scale it. That means pushing our attention to design detail and craft further, improving site performance and accessibility, and creating the kind of consumer-grade web experiences that make people stop and notice. Our marketing site is the window into everything we're building, and as Buffer grows (both in the creators and small teams we serve, and in the product itself), we want the site to reflect that energy and ambition.

You'll work closely with marketing leadership, our UX designer, and customer advocates to understand what our visitors need and figure out the best way to build it. You'll write and ship high-quality, tested code, and contribute to front-end engineering standards that raise the bar for consistency and quality across our marketing codebases. Working at Buffer is collaborative and positive thanks to our core values. title: Infrastructure Engineer

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. About the Role

As an Infrastructure Engineer at Mercor, you’ll build and scale the systems that power our rapid growth. You’ll ensure our infrastructure is highly available, cost-effective, and able to handle explosive traffic and compute demands. You’ll work closely with engineers across product, research, and operations to design scalable architectures, streamline deployments, and improve observability.

We’re hiring broadly across Infrastructure: Developer Productivity Engineer and Database Engineer and Platform Engineer. Candidates will be team-matched after the first screen, so we encourage you to apply even if your experience is stronger in one area than another.

- Designing and maintaining core infrastructure across cloud environments.

- Building Infrastructure-as-Code workflows to automate deployments and scaling.

- Improving monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to maintain reliability.

- Managing CI/CD pipelines (Github, Spacelift) to ensure seamless deployments.

- Supporting disaster recovery planning and ensuring high availability of systems.

- Partnering with product and research teams to design architectures that scale with workload demands.

- Identifying and fixing performance bottlenecks in compute, storage, and networking.

What We’re Looking For

- Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS).

- Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform).

- Deep experience with containers and orchestration (Docker).

- Solid understanding of distributed architectures.

- Programming languages (Python, Go).

- Proven ability to ship reliable infrastructure in production environments.

- Growth mindset and eagerness to thrive in a hyper-growth, high-ownership environment.

Why Mercor

- Impact: Your work powers how the world’s leading AI labs train and test their models.

- Learning: Get early insights into frontier model capabilities months before the market.

- Growth: Work on both infrastructure and research-adjacent projects with fast paths to ownership.

Benefits

- Bi-annual performance bonus structure

- Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

- Up to $15k Relocation bonus

- $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

- $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

- Free Equinox membership

- $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

- $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

title: Chief Impact Officer
description:

The role focuses on creating measurable positive outcomes for communities, stakeholders, customers, employees, and the environment while aligning impact objectives with the organization's long-term business strategy. The CIO drives programs that enhance corporate responsibility, sustainable growth, and stakeholder value.

Impact Strategy & Vision

• Develop and execute the organization's impact strategy aligned with corporate mission and business objectives.

• Define measurable social, environmental, and economic impact goals.

• Integrate impact priorities into enterprise-wide strategic planning.

ESG & Sustainability Leadership

• Lead ESG, sustainability, and corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives.

• Ensure alignment of impact programs with sustainability frameworks and best practices.

• Drive initiatives focused on climate action, social inclusion, and responsible governance.

Social Impact & Community Engagement

• Develop programs that create meaningful impact within communities and stakeholder groups.

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships

• Engage with investors, clients, regulators, community leaders, and advocacy groups.

• Build strategic partnerships that strengthen organizational impact and reputation.

• Represent the organization in sustainability and impact-focused forums.

Sustainable Business Integration

• Collaborate with business units to embed impact principles into products, services, and operations.

• Support responsible investment and sustainable business initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to create shared value through innovation and strategic growth.

Governance & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with ESG, sustainability, and social responsibility standards and regulations.

• Establish governance frameworks to support accountability and transparency.

• Coordinate with legal, compliance, and risk management teams.

Employee Engagement & Culture

• Promote a purpose-driven and socially responsible organizational culture.

• Drive employee engagement initiatives related to sustainability and social impact.

• Foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and employee well-being programs.

Leadership & Organizational Development

• Lead and mentor sustainability, CSR, ESG, and impact teams.

• Build cross-functional collaboration around impact initiatives.

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in impact strategies.
